summary: Sony Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing its ongoing share repurchase program. The filing covers repurchases during July 2026, with 18,891,500 shares bought for ¥66.4 billion. The board-authorized program, approved May 8, 2026, allows up to 230 million shares (about 3.89% of shares outstanding) or ¥500 billion, running through May 10, 2027. As of July 31, 2026, Sony had repurchased 55,968,100 shares for ¥193.9 billion. Repurchases are executed via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading contract. Watch execution pace relative to the program cap.
